description: The database layer: add the RBAC models to the Prisma schema, hand-author the identity_rbac_b2 migration (tables + in-migration catalogue/template/role-permission seed + membership & membership-role backfill + guards + composite FKs + RLS + GRANTs) mirroring the FROZEN B-1 migration patterns, make the seed idempotent for the new entities, and extend the live cross-tenant escape suite + its teardown for the two new tenant-owned tables. Depends on FEAT-001 (the migration transcribes PERMISSIONS/ROLE_PERMISSIONS; the seed imports them from @campusgate/shared/dist). Authoritative SQL = design §2, §3, §9.
steps: Edit c:/campusgate/packages/db/prisma/schema.prisma per design §2: add `enum MembershipStatus { ACTIVE SUSPENDED }`; add to model User the fields `phone String?`, `mfaEnabled Boolean @default(false)`, `mfaSecret String?`, and relation `memberships InstitutionMembership[]` (KEEP role, institutionId, the (id,institutionId) unique, everything else); add model InstitutionMembership (§2.2: id cuid, userId, institutionId, membershipStatus MembershipStatus @default(ACTIVE), departmentScope String?, permissionsVersion Int @default(0), createdAt/updatedAt, relations to User + Institution + MembershipRole[], @@unique([userId, institutionId]), @@unique([id, institutionId]), @@index([institutionId]), @@index([userId]), @@map("institution_memberships")); model Role (§2.4: id, key, name, institutionId String?, relation Institution?, permissions RolePermission[], memberships MembershipRole[], @@unique([key, institutionId]), @@index([institutionId]), @@map("roles")); model Permission (§2.3: id, key @unique, module, description, roleLinks RolePermission[], @@index([module]), @@map("permissions")); model MembershipRole (§2.5: id, membershipId, roleId, institutionId String, createdAt/updatedAt, relations, @@unique([membershipId, roleId]), @@index([institutionId]), @@map("membership_roles") — NO @@unique([id, institutionId])); model RolePermission (§2.6: id, roleId, permissionId, relations, @@unique([roleId, permissionId]), @@map("role_permissions")); add Institution back-relations (memberships, roles). Add NO DB-level id default (ids stay @default(cuid())).
Validate + regenerate: `npx prisma validate --schema=packages/db/prisma/schema.prisma` and `npx prisma generate` from packages/db.

Scaffold the migration from packages/db: `npx prisma migrate dev --name identity_rbac_b2 --create-only`, then REPLACE the generated migration.sql with the hand-authored ordered script from design §3.1: (1) CREATE the 5 tables, institutionId NULLABLE on institution_memberships + membership_roles; (2) single-column FKs (membership_roles.roleId→roles(id); role_permissions.roleId→roles(id) + permissionId→permissions(id); institution_memberships.institutionId→institutions(id); roles.institutionId→institutions(id)); (2a) `CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "roles_key_template_unique" ON "roles" ("key") WHERE "institutionId" IS NULL`; (2b) in-migration seed IN ORDER permissions→roles(5 templates, institutionId NULL, deterministic ids)→role_permissions, hand-transcribed from FEAT-001 PERMISSIONS + ROLE_PERMISSIONS, each with ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING; (3a) membership backfill INSERT ... SELECT 'mbr_'||gen_random_uuid()::text ... FROM users WHERE role<>'SUPER_ADMIN' AND institutionId <> (SELECT id FROM institutions WHERE code='PLATFORM'); (3c) membership-role backfill 'mrl_'||gen_random_uuid()::text joining users.role→roles.key WHERE roles.institutionId IS NULL; (4) SET NOT NULL on both institutionId columns + a DO $$ RAISE EXCEPTION null-tenant guard + the exactly-one-membership-role guard with the design §3.1-step-4 SQL and message VERBATIM; (5) composite unique institution_memberships_id_institutionId_key + the three composite FKs ((userId,institutionId)→users RESTRICT; (departmentScope,institutionId)→departments RESTRICT MATCH SIMPLE nullable — NOT SET NULL; (membershipId,institutionId)→institution_memberships RESTRICT) + plain uniques (membership_roles(membershipId,roleId), institution_memberships(userId,institutionId)); (6) indexes on institutionId (both tenant tables) + userId (memberships) + permissions.module + roles.institutionId; (7) RLS DO $$ FOREACH t IN ARRAY['institution_memberships','membership_roles'] ENABLE+FORCE + tenant_isolation_select + tenant_isolation_modify keyed on current_setting('app.current_institution_id', true); (8) the idempotent campass_app GRANT DO $$ IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname='campass_app') block. NO CREATE EXTENSION. permissions/roles/role_permissions get NO RLS.

Apply the migration against live Supabase from packages/db: `npx prisma migrate dev` (or `migrate deploy`); confirm neither guard raises and `npx prisma migrate status` shows it applied. Retry on transient P1001 (local ap-south-1 latency, not a failure).

Edit c:/campusgate/packages/db/src/seed.ts per design §3.2 (idempotent, extends existing): upsert catalogue permissions from @campusgate/shared PERMISSIONS (upsert on key); resolve the 5 template roles with findFirst({where:{key, institutionId:null}}) + create-if-absent (NOT a null composite upsert); upsert role_permissions from ROLE_PERMISSIONS; for each demo user ensure a membership (upsert on (userId, institutionId)) + membership_roles.upsert on (membershipId, roleId) bound to the template role matching user.role — EXCEPT superadmin@campusgate.local which gets NO membership/membership-role. Keep every existing user.role enum.
Build shared first (seed imports dist), then run the seed from packages/db `npx tsx src/seed.ts` twice to prove idempotency.

Extend the escape suite TEARDOWN FIRST then assertions in c:/campusgate/apps/api/src/routes/__tests__/helpers/tenant-escape-setup.ts: add 'institution_memberships' and 'membership_roles' to RLS_TABLES; in cleanup() add adminClient.membershipRole.deleteMany({where}) then adminClient.institutionMembership.deleteMany({where}) BEFORE the existing user/department/institution deletes (child-first, respecting the new RESTRICT composite FKs); add both tables to countRemainingTestRows(); extend seedTenant() if the new tests seed memberships under the ESCAPE_TEST_ prefix. In c:/campusgate/apps/api/src/routes/__tests__/tenant-escape.integration.test.ts add a membership_roles read-escape test (tenant A cannot see B's membership-role) and a spoofed-tenant-insert test (tenant A cannot insert a membership-role stamped B's institutionId).
acceptance_criteria: `npx prisma validate` passes and `npx prisma generate` produces a client with InstitutionMembership/Role/Permission/MembershipRole/RolePermission models and the new User fields

`npx prisma migrate dev` (or deploy) applies the identity_rbac_b2 migration against live Supabase with no error; both DO $$ guards pass (exactly one membership-role per non-superadmin, non-PLATFORM membership; no null tenant); `npx prisma migrate status` shows it applied
The B-1 migration 20261018110658_tenancy_isolation_rls file is byte-for-byte unchanged
`npx tsx src/seed.ts` from packages/db completes and re-running it creates no duplicates (idempotent)

The live escape suite passes: meta-test 6 now asserts RLS enabled+forced + both policies on institution_memberships and membership_roles; the new read-escape and spoofed-insert tests pass; teardown leaves countRemainingTestRows()===0
verification: From packages/db: `npx prisma validate --schema=prisma/schema.prisma` && `npx prisma generate` succeed
From packages/db: `npx prisma migrate deploy` applies cleanly (or `migrate dev` while authoring); `npx prisma migrate status` reports no pending migration
From repo root: `npm run build --workspace @campusgate/shared` then from packages/db `npx tsx src/seed.ts` twice — second run reports no new rows / no error

From apps/api: `npx vitest run src/routes/__tests__/tenant-escape.integration.test.ts` — all escape tests (incl. the two new membership_roles cases and meta-test 6 over the two new tables) pass and teardown asserts zero remaining rows
findings:
DONE. Schema + hand-authored migration + idempotent seed + escape-suite extension all applied against LIVE Supabase and verified. Full monorepo build green (3/3 workspaces); full api suite green (12 files / 111 tests, including the live escape suite). B-1 migration 20261018110658_tenancy_isolation_rls is byte-for-byte unchanged (git diff empty). campass_app never granted BYPASSRLS.

=== CROSS-FEATURE FACTS FOR FEAT-003/004 ===

MIGRATION DIRECTORY NAME (pin the catalogue-sync meta-test to this exact file): `20261018171747_identity_rbac_b2` -> packages/db/prisma/migrations/20261018171747_identity_rbac_b2/migration.sql. Its in-migration seed block hand-transcribes the 39 permission keys + 44 (roleKey, permissionKey) pairs from @campusgate/shared PERMISSIONS/ROLE_PERMISSIONS (ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING). Live DB verified: 39 permissions, 5 template roles, 44 role_permissions, 4 memberships, 4 membership-roles (== 4 non-SUPER_ADMIN, non-PLATFORM users), superadmin has 0 memberships.

*** ENUM RENAME (load-bearing, approved by user Option A): the legacy Prisma enum `Role` was RENAMED to `UserRole` *** because Prisma forbids a model named `Role` alongside an enum `Role`. The new model is named `Role` exactly as the design specifies (table `roles`, delegate `prisma.role`). The enum VALUES (STUDENT|HOD|GUARD|ADMIN|SUPER_ADMIN) and every stored `users.role` value are UNCHANGED — the migration does `ALTER TYPE "Role" RENAME TO "UserRole"` (pure in-place rename, no data migration). FEAT-003/004 MUST import the enum TYPE as `UserRole` (not `Role`) from @campusgate/db; the string literal values are identical. The DB type is now `"UserRole"`. Already updated: apps/api/src/middleware/auth.ts (import { type UserRole }, the FastifyJWT payload/user `role: UserRole`, requireRole/requireTenantRole signatures). Any other file importing the enum type must use `UserRole`; `request.user.role`, `prisma.user ... role: "STUDENT"` string usages need NO change.

TEMPLATE ROLE IDS (deterministic, from the migration step 2b — stable for joins/seeds): role_template_student (STUDENT), role_template_guard (GUARD), role_template_hod (HOD), role_template_admin (ADMIN), role_template_super_admin (SUPER_ADMIN). All have institutionId = NULL. Resolve templates with findFirst({ where: { key, institutionId: null } }) — NEVER a null composite upsert (partial unique index `roles_key_template_unique` guards one template per key). Permission ids are deterministic too: `perm_` + key with dots/non-alnum as `_` (e.g. perm_campus_movement_pass_request, perm_admin_users_view, perm_platform_institutions_manage). SUPER_ADMIN template maps ONLY to platform.* (no campus_movement./admin.*), so a super-admin 403s on every tenant requirePermission — matching today's requireTenantRole rejection.

MEMBERSHIP ROW SHAPE (institution_memberships): { id (cuid via Prisma for app inserts; backfill rows are `mbr_`+gen_random_uuid()::text), userId, institutionId (NOT NULL, tenant key), membershipStatus MembershipStatus @default(ACTIVE) [enum values ACTIVE|SUSPENDED], departmentScope String? (nullable FK -> departments(id,institutionId) MATCH SIMPLE RESTRICT), permissionsVersion Int @default(0), createdAt, updatedAt }. Unique on (userId, institutionId) AND (id, institutionId). The authenticate pipeline (FEAT-003) loads the membership via privilegedPrisma by (userId, institutionId) and selects { id, membershipStatus, permissionsVersion, roles -> role.key, role.permissions.permission.key }. MEMBERSHIP-ROLE shape (membership_roles): { id (app: cuid; backfill: `mrl_`+gen_random_uuid()::text), membershipId, roleId (single-col FK -> roles(id); NOT composite — templates are global), institutionId String (NOT NULL, denormalised tenant), createdAt, updatedAt }. Unique on (membershipId, roleId). NO (id, institutionId) composite unique on membership_roles (nothing references it as a composite-FK parent in Phase 0).

RLS: institution_memberships + membership_roles are RLS ENABLE+FORCE with tenant_isolation_select + tenant_isolation_modify keyed on current_setting('app.current_institution_id', true) — both verified live. permissions/roles/role_permissions have NO RLS (global/template), read via privilegedPrisma only (an RLS `=` policy would fail-closed on the NULL template institutionId). So the authenticate membership/role/permission reads MUST run on privilegedPrisma (pre-tenant-context), never withTenant.

ESCAPE SUITE: RLS_TABLES now includes 'institution_memberships' and 'membership_roles'; seedTenant() seeds a membership + membership-role (bound to the STUDENT template) per tenant under the ESCAPE_TEST_ prefix; cleanup() deletes membershipRole -> institutionMembership BEFORE users/departments/institutions (child-first, respecting the new RESTRICT composite FKs); countRemainingTestRows() counts both new tables and runs SEQUENTIALLY (session pooler caps at 15 clients — Promise.all tripped EMAXCONNSESSION). Two new tests pass: membership_roles read-escape + spoofed-tenant-insert (WITH CHECK rejects institutionId=B under A's context).

SEED: packages/db/src/seed.ts now imports PERMISSIONS/ROLE_PERMISSIONS from @campusgate/shared (so build @campusgate/shared FIRST — it resolves to dist at runtime), seeds catalogue (createMany skipDuplicates), template roles (find-first-then-create), role_permissions (createMany skipDuplicates), and one membership + membership-role per demo user EXCEPT superadmin@campusgate.local. Idempotent: ran twice, counts unchanged (39/5/44/4/4). NOTE on live ap-south-1 latency: plain seed/queries intermittently P1001 on 5432/6543 — retried, not a failure.
